answers.core: It would make much more flexible the new FoldableContainer, and by making it as an add-on would require to re-implement the complete node, and wouldn´t perform as well as the out of the box node, which was one of the main concerns for adding this node in the first place even thought similar add-ons  alredy existing.
answers.workaround: To some very specific scenarios may be possible some work arounds with the clip content property of the regular control node as I did for the examples, but using a regular control node as a container is not ideal and brings more problems, that has no easy solution, even more were it needs to be inside more containers, like multiple FoldableContainers inside a Vbox
